fields.title: 8. Three data points to check directly before the next run
fields.md:
1. **R2 evidence reinforcement**: SpaceX's official flight summary of the Flight 15 Ship catch (spacex.com flight page · SpaceX X account) or a second top-tier report (Reuters·Bloomberg·WSJ·FT·AP). If either is confirmed, R2 triggering and one recovery for B-2027-1 are recorded in the same run (source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run` item 1).
2. **FAA**: Whether a mishap investigation is designated for Flight 15 (booster loss) and the Flight 16 license (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T3]` check ③④).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: T7 ⓒ 11/18 · T2 12/8 lock-up · T12 12/9 vote · Tesla merger 8-K (T6) · monthly 12/01 (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
